job.title: Senior Software Engineer, Observability
job.workplace: In office at least 3 days a week
job.pay_full: $196,000 – $230,000 a year base pay (Zone 1: Menlo Park, CA; New York, NY; Bellevue, WA; Washington, DC), plus bonus opportunities and equity

details.about: Robinhood's mission is to democratize finance for all. Its Observability team builds and owns the company's full-stack observability platform — metrics, logs, distributed tracing and alerting — and works with the Robinhood Command Center to keep those systems at or above 99.9% uptime. As a Senior Software Engineer here you are the technical lead for how Robinhood observes itself at scale, owning the observability control plane end to end and leading a team of six engineers.
duties: Define and execute the full-stack observability roadmap for metrics, logs, traces and alerting
Own and evolve the observability control plane, including telemetry ingestion pipelines and cost management
Lead and work with a team of six engineers to build scalable, self-service observability tools
Set and maintain SLOs so the observability platform meets or exceeds the 99.9% uptime target
Partner with the Robinhood Command Center and engineering teams on dependency mapping, incident response and observability standards
needs: 5+ years of software engineering, with a track record of owning large-scale observability or infrastructure platform initiatives
Deep expertise in Kubernetes and public cloud (AWS preferred), architecting and operating distributed systems at scale
Strong coding in Go, Python or similar, including integrating observability agents, libraries and instrumentation into production code
Experience owning an observability control plane or telemetry pipeline, including ingestion cost management, cardinality control and signal routing
nice: Experience with the Vector data pipeline or similar log/metrics routing tools, and with Prometheus, Grafana, Honeycomb, Humio or Sentry
details.benefits: Base pay $196,000 – $230,000 a year in Zone 1 (Menlo Park, CA; New York, NY; Bellevue, WA; Washington, DC); Zone 2 (Denver, CO; Westlake, TX; Chicago, IL) is $172,000 – $202,000 and Zone 3 (Lake Mary, Clearwater and Gainesville, FL) is $153,000 – $179,000. The role is also eligible for bonus opportunities and equity. Benefits include 401(k) matching, 100% paid health insurance for employees with 90% coverage for dependents, a lifestyle wallet for wellness and learning, employer-paid life and disability insurance, fertility and mental health benefits, company holidays, paid time off, sick time and parental leave, plus catered meals in the office.
notes: Based in the Menlo Park, CA office with in-person attendance at least 3 days a week
Leads a team of six engineers
